signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: ECB lanceert Pontes voor afwikkeling van gettokeniseerde activa zonder stablecoins
signals.summary: Pontes will expand its services and operating hours gradually, with full implementation expected by 2028 and more participants set to join.

signals.title: Google en Apple werven expertise voor stablecoin- en tokeniseringsplatformen
signals.summary: Google and Apple seek crypto talent as Big Tech eyes stablecoin and tokenization rails

signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: ECB koopt tokeniseerde staatsobligaties via Pontes DLT-platform
signals.summary: The ECB aims to gain firsthand DLT market experience by buying tokenized public-sector securities and settling the trades through Pontes.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: SoFi start stablecoin-afwikkeling op Mastercard-netwerk, kaartprogramma mikend op 25 miljard dollar jaarlijks volume
signals.summary: SoFi launches live SoFiUSD stablecoin settlement on Mastercard's network, with its card program targeting $25 billion in annualized volume.

signals.title: Ineos staakt drie Britse chemische fabrieken door gestegen gasprijzen
signals.summary: Sir Jim Ratcliffe-owned conglomerate suspends factories in Hull, which support 4,000 jobs, as oil and gas prices surge on Iran war
